scenario:
A global fashion retail company is implementing an enterprise-level Size and Fit Management System to streamline the standardization of clothing sizes across different brands and regions. The system is designed to manage a comprehensive database of clothing sizes, measurements, and conversions to offer customers accurate sizing information and improve their shopping experience.

The platform should support various clothing categories (such as tops, bottoms, and outerwear) and handle size variations across international markets. It must allow brands to input their size charts, including measurements such as bust, waist, and hip, and provide an automated system for converting these sizes into standardized formats (like XS, S, M, L) as well as numeric sizes.

Advanced analytics capabilities are required to analyze customer fit feedback, return rates, and regional size preferences. The system should also integrate with e-commerce platforms to provide real-time size recommendations based on individual customer profiles and past purchase data. Additionally, a comprehensive user management system is needed, with roles and permissions for brand managers, data analysts, and customer service representatives to ensure data integrity and facilitate user collaboration.
